name: mobilecannon-tow-slope
description: T-009: on the KydlFlat template mountain cliff (20 m rise over a 25 m run, about 39 degrees; the template own slope, nothing built) the Asksvin tows the Mobile Cannon down the face, turns round below and tows it back up onto the top: the cannon never flips (the upright keeper logs every hold) and stays hitched. The Asksvin runs straight down and up the face (asksvinDriveTo): the pathfinder found no way down in 2 of 3 runs.
